verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's own docs describe its first-party HyperAgent framework as open-source, so part of the product's code is readable. The core cloud browser and session service is never shown to be open source, and no license is named. Missing for 10: an open license for the core platform, a named license (e.g. MIT or Apache), a linked source repository for HyperAgent, and independent confirmation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: HyperAgent is our open-source tool that supercharges Playwright with AI.
HyperAgent is an open-source browser automation framework that extends Playwright with AI capabilities.
